sameDayRetelling: Wren Ash went down after his grandfather Vale was killed by Skusk the skeleton at D18, and I had written him one rule, "foes ≥ 4 → to corridor". He broke the Warlord, avenged Skusk at the Lich, swapped into mirror read for the Foundry Master and reached D28 with $18k in his pack. There the lurker queen "listens", twelve lurkers held every side, and my corridor rule failed "no path"; he died at 1 hp, and the death screen told me a silence scroll would have saved him 4 times out of 12.

humanProbes.clarity: Mostly yes - the forecast said "VS LAST RUN · D19 −37 · full haul 50→13% · death 50→88%" the instant I added a rule - but "default 36% · chores 64%" was never explained, the "Warlord tactic" button opened a generic tactics sheet, "close" sat next to real close buttons meaning a close outcome, and "▶ watch kill" did nothing.
humanProbes.decisions: I added "depth ≥ 20 → bank" (death <13%, avg $1259/run) and removed it to push on (death >87%, avg $17160/run), and I'd make that call again; but tactics "compare outcomes" came back "close" for every option three times out of three.
humanProbes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know a condition could save a scroll; now I narrow rules ("foe: boss" + "in: deep" → read silence took death from 50% to 25%) and read traces like "to corridor vs 4+ · no path ← foes on every side".
humanProbes.tension: I sweated the D28 lurker floor ("death 67→7%" on the fix list) and the 87%-death push, but D1-D18 later one-shot everything ("−22 hp"), the King died while I was away, and Ascension 1 was a seven-minute walkover.
humanProbes.feel: Callouts landed - "OGRE WINDS UP", "REFLECTED!", "CORRIDOR ✗ NO PATH" - and the drill-in/out of sheets was snappy, but the phone-size board is small and murky and the log floods; audio unassessed.
humanProbes.surprise: "The monkey stole the violet potion?", "Skusk the skeleton is avenged.", being paralysed to death by a mirror shade at 3/51, and the lurker queen "listens" all changed what I configured; the same Warlord/Mother/Lich order repeated every run.
humanProbes.expression: The chronicle titled two heirs "the chokepoint fighter" after my corridor rule; my set was 3 hand rules over Guarded + boss focus + Mirror rhythm.
humanProbes.story: Vale fell to Skusk at D18; Wren "found ♟1's bones" and avenged Skusk, then fell to Krak the lurker; Yara "avenged Krak", took the Queen and fell to Morusk the mirror shade.
humanProbes.pacing: Check-ins were 1-5 minutes and early floors fold into "D9–12 · 100% · +$292" cards, but at D23 "alert 8/8" smiths kept my hero shuffling "foes 4+ → corridor ×8" for over three real minutes.
humanProbes.failure: "lurker · D28 · hero at 1 hp · YOU DIED" with "fixes · 12 replays of D28 ... hp < 50% → read unknown · survives 12/12" is the clearest loss screen I've used; my blame went to my own corridor rule's "no path".
humanProbes.social: Nobody else; the closest was the named nemesis line - "grudge: Krak the lurker" then "Krak the lurker is avenged." - and named workers like the apprentice who spent "−$3600" for me.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose to push into an 87% death forecast, to begin "Ascension 1 · Harder dungeon · same bloodline", and once took "Hand control · awaits order" mid-run though nothing asked me to.
humanProbes.progression: Within runs gold climbed to "Carried $43602"; between runs forge tiers, Legacy ranks and tactic levels ("Guarded L5"); automation came as scout, porter, apprentice, drillmaster - but by Ascension 2 I had "$64833" and the forge said "Kit complete".
humanProbes.aesthetic: The pixel town at night with a campfire and the torn red death banner ("YOU DIED" wax seal) are places I'd sit in; the ending art of the hero facing ruined arches was lovely.
humanProbes.return: I came back to "While away · D33 · $15301 · Pick one" and chose the forge discount; after 8h it was "Boss defeated · Mirror King · ▶ watch kill" - which did nothing - and I would rather have stayed for that.
humanProbes.attribution: "D28 · boss → read silence" fired at the Queen because I wrote it, and "D13 · foes 4+ → corridor" was my rule; my Wren died where my corridor rule said "no path" - but reports say "taught 1–4%", so the packages did most of the playing.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Forecast deltas and traces are clear ("VS LAST RUN · D19 −37"); repeated lapses: unexplained "default 36% · chores 64%", "Warlord tactic" opened a generic sheet, "close" outcome label beside close buttons, stale "reach D15" quest at D33, inert "▶ watch kill".

Real foreseeable trade-off: "depth ≥ 20 → bank" gave death <13% but avg $1259/run vs push at $17160/run. Undercut by tactics compare returning "close" for all 8-10 options three times and forecasts at "±34" that flipped the same config from death <13% to 38-50%.
Learned to narrow conditions: adding "in: deep" to the silence rule moved "full haul 0→63% · death 100→25%". Later depth came mostly from forge/legacy, and the ascensions taught nothing new.

Chosen stakes existed (pushing into "death >87%"; D28 deaths at 1 hp) but the climax (King) resolved offline unseen, early floors became "−22 hp" one-shots, and Ascension 1 was cleared live with no doubt at all.
